reviews.comment: I have no doubt that he knows what he's talking about. However, he explains topics to us as if we should already know them. He didn't give us much final exam prep other than that anything could be on the final, though he did say not to worry about topics from previous exams. He then gave us a final that was roughly 40% previous exam questions.

Avoid this professor if you can. He said there was going to be very little from previous exams on the final, but 30-40% of the questions were word-for-word from previous exams. On top of that, the lectures are extremely difficult to understand. He also doesn't post his notes. If you have to take this prof, use MITs linear algebra lectures to study.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor made relatively simple topics exceedingly overcomplicated to no benefit; leaving many students including myself to have more fruitful studying from youtube videos than the professor himself. He was gone for many classes early in the semester; days which the students rejoiced because the substitute was leagues more helpful.

This prof genuinely sucks. 32 kids Q dropped his class. 75% of the class prior to the final needed anywhere from a 55-77 on the final exam to PASS. Notes weren't posted bc he didn't want to deal with the ADA. Lectures were useless, learned more from online than going to class. I'd much rather walk through fire naked than take this class again.

Collin Victor's lectures didn't contribute to my learning in this class at all. Doing well in the class is possible, but it is going to require TONS of work outside of class to make up for the lack of "teaching" in class. It seems that he simply copies down his printed notes onto his iPad in class without adding much else to them. Good luck w/ him.
I need a cigarette.

Who was Collin Victor? Do you mean ChatGPT, Gemini, and the month we had subs teach the class. Awful professor who isn't clear, won't post notes because (word for word) “…too lazy to abide by accessibility laws to post…”, and doesn't care for you. Avoid at all cost, if you have to take his class then switch to a different university. Godspeed.
prof would base all exams on homework, but would post solutions for the homework that showed how to complete the work; they only showed the correct answer with no work for most problems.

I don't believe he should he a professor. He is a terrible lecturer and grader, and is very difficult to work with. This is the first class that has made me rethink my life choices, and it's because of this man. I am trembling as I write this because this man made this class a waste of time with no merit to effort spent.

BEWARE AT ALL COSTS!!!!!!! This professor doesnt care about you or your life. He straight up talks openly about how he doesnt. He will recite notes, but not actually teach them. HW's are unlearnable without the use of outside methods and same with tests. I AM A NUKE STUDENT AND THIS WAS THE HARDEST CLASS, A MATH CLASS. I hope you get someone else.

This "teacher" is so incredibly bad I don't know if it could be put into words that I am allowed to say on this platform. I have heard people say things about him I don't care to repeat for the sake of my shot at heaven, all of which are very justified. This has been the worst academic experience of my life. Maybe a coma would help me forget.

I'm proud to say Collin Victor is one of the devil's strongest workers. I confidently did not learn anything in lecture that actively helped me on either the homework or exams except for the days that he was gone and subs came in to teach for him instead. Every day of this miserable class I daydream of the subs teaching again. Avoid at all costs.

Collin Victor seems like a neat guy outside of class; however, he taught the course as if it were a graduate-level course, regularly using terminology and symbols we had never seen before, with little to no explanation about what they were. Proofs weren't taught well or sometimes not at all, yet were a significant portion of the Exam and HW grades.

Prof. Victor's teaching style of of re-writing sections of the textbook onto his ipad does not work.

You had little to no idea even where to start on the homework. However, exams were exactly like the homework and were graded 110/100. 

I had to put in a lot of work outside of class in order to get an A.
anyone complaining about math 309 must be a little slow. the exams were literally just homework questions with no new surprises.

I have never suffered like I suffered here. This has been the worst class of my life, he somehow managed to make the already complex topics 100x worse, he did not release his notes, his exams are awful to take. This class has zero redeeming qualities. If I pass his final in a few days it will be in spite of his "teaching" not because of it.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Awful lecturer.  Class notes were both confusing and not accessible outside of class. There are very few resources provided outside of the homework. The grades are all based on the exams, however they are able to be studied for solely on the homework but is free response proof heavy. Good class if you want to self study, awful if you want to learn.

Horrible prof, lectures were confusing with little clarification on things (he would often skip half the work for example questions). Impossible to reach outside of class, homeworks and exams were nothing like lectures, and while possible to study for, Youtube, textbooks, and Chat GPT taught me everything for the class. other reviews misleading.

Victor makes a hard subject not too bad. He can sometimes overcomplicate things in his lectures, but he is otherwise a good professor, and he's good 1-on-1. Homework is as difficult as they need to be, and that follows his exams. No quizzes either. If you study the HW and understand everything you'll get an A. Super chill dude. Take him if you can.

His lectures were very clear with lots of relevant examples. He's a super nice guy and very approachable for questions. His exams were very reasonable, and if he felt the class struggling on something he would change that section of the exam accordingly. Weekly take-home quizzes that were super similar to the tests and helped me to prepare.

Good lecturer, answers questions well. His exams and quizzes are very very reasonable, if he has to rush through something in class he'll remove it from the exam or make the questions on it easier. If you paid attention at all, you'll be completely prepared for the tests. He prepares his students well.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Although new, shy, and quiet, his lectures are all you need to do the hw. He is a nice professor and is not trying to screw you over. His grading isnt tough and the quizzes, he tries to make easy so that he can help you. Very hard class. To get an A, know how to do EVERY hw problem. Exams are fair and difficult. I would take him again.

A new prof, who was learning how to teach. Had to self taught the materials (Joe's website saved my life, love that guy) but later his notes became really helpful. Notes are thorough and hoesntly you will understand even without going to classes. 
Give a lot of practice exams and the take home quizzes are easy.

This professor was honestly just a really chill guy. His classes were consisted of him reading proofs and equations then showing them applied through practice problems. He posted lecture notes on canvas. Encouraged questions and was willing to answer them. For exams he provided numerous practice exams and worked out solutions. Would recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Collin is a really casual guy and he lays out what is expected for the course clearly. He always replied to emails very quickly and would get exam grades out in about a week. Lectures were kind of monotone but his notes are laid out pretty well, plus he would post old exams on canvas as a review.

He is a very boring lecturer and I ended up skipping many lectures. I essentially self-taught myself the course using his lecture notes which I though was a better use of my time than going to class. If you are okay with that, take him. But I will say that I will come out of this class not knowing any of the material in depth.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He is such a chill professor that is always willing to explain things to you. Even though lecture is not mandatory he did say that he might have pop quizzes but he has never given out one. The notes were always posted after the lecture material had been completed so if you decide to skip you can always get the notes.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Collin is just a really chill dude who is very willing to explain and help. Of course, you can self learn this course, and although he's bothered by it, it is doable, making his classes very flexible and just really nice to take. Man, he's just a straightforward and honest guy who's really nice, no complaints whatsoever.
